responsibility: This header defines the `xgene1_tunings` model for AppliedMicro X-Gene 1 in the AArch64 backend. It supplies X-Gene-1-specific address costs, register-move penalties, AdvSIMD vector costs, approximation modes, prefetch settings, issue rate, and non-fusing policy, forming the named `tune_params` bundle that backend costing and scheduling logic uses for this early server-class AArch64 core.
